name: Antarctic Circumpolar Current
scope: Approximate circumpolar path; source calls it the longest wind-driven current.

name: Agulhas Current
scope: Regional southward Agulhas reference route from 27 degrees S to a 40 degrees S retroflection gate near 19 degrees E. Includes an editorial approach to the turning region; stops before the eastward Agulhas Return Current. Excludes upstream Mozambique/East Madagascar branches, leakage and ring trajectories. This is a regional extent convention, not the narrower coastal-jet definition or whole Agulhas system.

name: Agulhas Return Current
scope: Source-scoped named-current extent from first clear evidence near 16 degrees E to loss of a recognizable jet between 66 and 70 degrees E. Does not include the subsequent South Indian Ocean Current or northern leakage branches.

name: Alaska Current
scope: Regional northward Alaska Current branch offshore British Columbia and southeast Alaska, using OSW latitude gates at 48 and 58.5 degrees N. Excludes the northern/northwestern Alaskan Stream, the distinct nearshore Alaska Coastal Current, individual fjords and offshore eddy excursions. Gate alternatives vary the regional reach; not the entire counterclockwise Gulf of Alaska gyre or an observed continuous shelf-edge jet.

name: Alaska Coastal Current (Gulf of Alaska)
basin: North Pacific / Gulf of Alaska and eastern Aleutians
scope: Stabeno et al. (2016) report an approximate 1,700 km coastal system between Seward and Samalga Pass. This is the northern Gulf of Alaska/eastern Aleutian scope, separate from the offshore Alaska Current and Alaskan Stream. It does not cover every coastal flow sharing the Alaska Coastal Current name, including Arctic usage. The paper integrates intermittent observations from 1984-2014; this extent is not a measured simultaneous reference streamline or dated footprint.

name: Algerian Current
scope: Eastward Algerian coastal regional reference route from an OSW Alboran-transition gate to an OSW eastern Algeria gate. Alternative later western and earlier eastern gates test regional extent. Excludes Alboran gyres, detached Algerian eddies and downstream Sardinia-channel or other Mediterranean circulation. Source does not define exact terminal coordinates or whole-system termination.

name: Antarctic Slope Current
scope: Review-reported upper-continental-slope system span; not a measured reference streamline or dated footprint. The Antarctic Peninsula interrupts circumpolar continuity.

name: Antilles Current
scope: Antilles Current principal Bahamas-margin reference extent from the Turks/Caicos–southeastern Bahamas approach to the northeast-Abaco/Gulf Stream approach.

name: Atlantic Equatorial Undercurrent
scope: Atlantic EUC principal thermocline-jet reference extent from the offshore western-boundary feed sector to the eastern pre-island approach.

name: Atlantic North Equatorial Current
scope: Principal Atlantic NEC geographic reference extent from the offshore Canary-feed sector west of northwest Africa to the approach east of the Lesser Antilles.

name: Atlantic North Equatorial Countercurrent
scope: Atlantic NECC principal eastward basin reference extent from the North Brazil retroflection/feed sector to the Guinea Current handoff sector.

name: Atlantic South Equatorial Current
scope: Principal central Atlantic SEC geographic reference extent from its eastern-basin westward-flow sector to the offshore northeast-Brazil approach, using the approximately5S schematic branch.

name: Western and southern Australian boundary flow
scope: Continuous austral-winter shelf-edge flow from North West Cape to southern Tasmania, comprising the Leeuwin, South Australian, and Zeehan currents; not the length of Leeuwin alone.

name: Azores Current
scope: OSW reference corridor from a Grand Banks branch-region gate near 40 N / 45 W, southeast to the Mid-Atlantic Ridge near 34 N / 37 W, then eastward toward an offshore Gulf of Cadiz approach gate. Excludes upstream Gulf Stream, North Atlantic branch, Azores Countercurrent, southern recirculation, southward branches into the North Equatorial/Canary routes and Gibraltar/Mediterranean inflow. No whole connected-system length.

name: Baffin Current
scope: Baffin Current principal western-bay reference extent from the northern Baffin Bay feed sector through the western boundary into the Davis Strait handoff.

name: Balearic Current
scope: Northern Balearic island-margin corridor from an OSW Ibiza offshore approach to a gate north/northeast of Menorca. Excludes upstream mainland Northern Current, its cyclonic return loop, southward channel flow, Algerian eddies and downstream basin recirculation. No full connected-system length.

name: Benguela Current
scope: Specified northward shelf-edge Benguela regional reference branch from an offshore Cape Agulhas regional gate to the nominal 15 degrees S Angola–Benguela front region. Excludes broad offshore Benguela extensions, Agulhas ring paths, southward undercurrent and the entire upwelling-ecosystem perimeter. Gate coordinates are OSW regional approximations; no continuous measured shelf-edge axis is inferred.

name: Black Sea Rim Current
scope: One declared counterclockwise Black Sea basin-margin reference circuit under the surface geostrophic circulation convention. An arbitrary western anchor closes the path; it is not a current origin or termination. Excludes the interior Western/Eastern gyres, coastal eddy loops and branch sums. Historical Caucasus and Southern Current naming equivalence remains unresolved.

name: Brazil Current
scope: Poleward Brazil Current reference route from nominal 14 degrees S origin to nominal 38 degrees S confluence; alternate origins 10/15 degrees S and terminal proxies 34.5/40.5 degrees S. Excludes North Brazil Current, Brazil Return Current recirculation, eastward South Atlantic Current and deep intermediate undercurrent. Confluence-proxy positions are endpoint assumptions, not instantaneous observed axes.

name: California Current
scope: Approximate California Current System extent from Baja California Sur to northern Vancouver Island; not a measured California Current core axis.

name: Canary Current
scope: OSW offshore reference corridor from a regional northern source gate near 35 N, past the western Canary archipelago, to a Cape Blanc offshore departure gate near 21 N. Excludes upstream Azores/Portugal routes, the broader Iberian-to-tropical Canary Current System, Lanzarote Passage recirculation, poleward undercurrents and downstream North Equatorial Current. No whole connected-system length.

name: Caribbean Current
scope: Selected westward Caribbean regional route from a Windward Islands approach to the Belize/Yucatan transition near 19 N. Excludes the northward Yucatan Current, Loop and Florida currents, additional island entry branches, Colombia-Panama gyre circuits and eddy perimeters. No unique continuous axis or whole-system length asserted.

name: Davidson Current
scope: California-Oregon winter coastal reference corridor between OSW gates at 35 N and 46 N. These are bookkeeping gates, not source-published current endpoints. Excludes conditional Vancouver Island penetration and the deeper California Undercurrent. No full-system length or width footprint.

name: East Adriatic Current
scope: OSW offshore eastern-Adriatic reference corridor under the Otranto-to-Istria surface-circulation convention. Gates are editorial neighborhoods, not observed origins or termination. Excludes western return flow, sub-basin recirculation loops and unverified island-channel branches. The possible Dalmatian-name overlap is unresolved and its extent is not transferred. The published 800 km basin length is not used as current length; this estimate comes from the declared OSW vertices.

name: East African Coastal Current
scope: EACC/Zanzibar principal northward trunk reference extent from the SEC-fed southern sector to a fixed representative Somali-feed/convergence-sector handoff.

name: East Australian Current
scope: Coherent poleward shelf-break jet from about 15 degrees S to the usual separation around 32 degrees S; excludes Tasman Front and downstream eddy/extension routes.

name: East Greenland Current
scope: Regional outer/slope EGC reference corridor from the Fram Strait section at 78.5 degrees N to the study’s southern shelf boundary at 59 degrees N in the Cape Farewell region. Excludes a distinct East Greenland Coastal Current axis, interior export branches, upstream Arctic extensions and onward West Greenland Current. The 59 degrees N gate is the paper’s regional boundary, not a precise geographic coordinate of Cape Farewell.

name: East Greenland Coastal Current
scope: Conditional full southeast-Greenland coastal reference envelope from weak northern68N identification to Cape Farewell handoff. Excludes EGC shelfbreak route, offshore diversions and West Greenland continuation.

name: East India Coastal Current
basin: Bay of Bengal, northern Indian Ocean
scope: Declared November southward coastal envelope from offshore northern Bay of Bengal to southeast Sri Lanka monsoon-current handoff. No basin-interior gyre, offshore freshwater plume or downstream monsoon leg included.

name: Falkland (Malvinas) Current
scope: Source-reported approximate 2,000 km northward loop of the northern Antarctic Circumpolar Current branch in the Argentine Basin, from a 2009 EGU conference abstract. No reference centerline, endpoint coordinates, depth-defined length or uncertainty is supplied. Do not interpret this as a measured dated path, a shelf-break front length, or an independently specified Malvinas Return Current extent.

name: Florida Current
scope: Tomczak and Godfrey report approximately 1,200 km from the Florida Straits along the coast to separation near Cape Hatteras. This is the Florida Current segment of the Gulf Stream System, not a whole-system length or a measured reference streamline. NOAA's glossary independently names the same segment; NASA and NOAA Coast Pilot sometimes use Gulf Stream more broadly for the Florida Straits flow.

name: Gaspé Current
scope: OSW southern lower-estuary offshore approach near Pointe-des-Monts latitude, along the Gaspe Peninsula and toward a gate north of the Magdalen Islands. Excludes upstream river/estuary length, episodic north-shore feeder, Anticosti Gyre circuit, Chaleur Bay recirculation and Cabot Strait/Scotian downstream routes. No full connected-system length.

name: Guiana Current
scope: Guiana Current principal offshore Guianas-coast reference extent from the North Brazil feed-sector approach to the east-Trinidad/Caribbean approach.

name: Guinea Current
scope: Cape Palmas offshore approach to the Togo-Benin weakening transition near 2 E. Regional route convention, not the full Guinea Current extent. Excludes upstream equatorial countercurrent, Guinea Counter Current, Guinea Under Current, plume recirculation and eddy excursions.

name: Gulf Stream
scope: Tomczak and Godfrey report approximately 2,500 km for the Gulf Stream proper as an open-ocean free jet downstream of Cape Hatteras toward the Newfoundland Rise/Grand Banks near 50°W. This excludes the Florida Current and North Atlantic Current; it is a textbook path-scale description, not a measured reference streamline. NOAA's glossary uses the same strict segment definition, while NASA and NOAA Coast Pilot sometimes use Gulf Stream more broadly.

name: Hiri Current
scope: Broad Hiri naming convention: northward Australian boundary branch from an OSW 15 S bifurcation approach, clockwise around the Gulf of Papua entrance, to an OSW eastern Louisiade approach. Excludes closed gyre return circuits, direct mid-basin Solomon inflow, EAC, downstream New Guinea currents and eddy excursions. Narrower literature uses Hiri only south of PNG and proposes Gulf of Papua Current for the connected boundary system; no alias merge or complete system extent admitted.

name: Indian South Equatorial Current
scope: Indian SEC principal basin reference extent from the eastern Indonesian-throughflow-fed sector to the offshore eastern Madagascar bifurcation approach.

name: Irminger Current
scope: Northward eastern-Irminger-Sea reference branch along the western Reykjanes Ridge flank, from an OSW southern ridge gate at 56 N to an OSW pre-bifurcation gate near 65 N south of Denmark Strait. Excludes return flow toward Greenland, North Icelandic Irminger continuation, interior Irminger Gyre circuits, offshore eddies, opposite East Reykjanes Ridge Current and deep overflow currents. Gates are regional comparison choices, not established whole-current endpoints.

name: Jutland Current
scope: Danish west-coast reference corridor from an OSW German Bight approach gate to an offshore northern-Jutland/Skagerrak approach gate. Excludes upstream English Channel and southern North Sea circuits, Baltic Current inflow and Norwegian Coastal Current continuation. No North/South Jutland branch lengths or aliases admitted.

name: Kuroshio Current
scope: Approximate Kuroshio journey from about 12°N to 35°N in the western North Pacific; not a measured whole-current axis, and the Kuroshio Extension is separate.

name: Kuroshio Extension
scope: NOAA glossary Kuroshio Extension extent from approximately 145 to 160 degrees E, upstream of its separately named North Pacific Current. This naming convention is not a universal termination rule for all Kuroshio Extension literature; excludes the coastal Kuroshio, recirculation gyres and downstream North Pacific extent.

name: Labrador Current
scope: Main offshore Labrador regional branch from an OSW southern Davis Strait gate at 60 N, along Labrador and east Newfoundland, via the western Flemish Pass region to an OSW tail-of-Grand-Banks gate at 43 N. Excludes upstream Baffin/West Greenland feeder paths, Hudson Strait intrusion, inshore Avalon branch, offshore eddy excursions and downstream westward/eastward branches. Source defines regions, not exact gates or a whole-system termination.

name: Leeuwin Current
scope: Source-convention Leeuwin component from the North West Cape regional gate near 22 degrees S, southward around Cape Leeuwin and eastward into the central Great Australian Bight. Nominal eastern gate 130 degrees E uses the source's winter water-mass penetration convention; alternative 125 degrees E tests a shorter central-Bight naming convention. Excludes the North West Shelf, offshore eddies, South Australian and Zeehan components. Not the full 5,500 km boundary-flow system.

name: Ligurian Current
scope: Declared Ligurian regional segment of the Northern Current: north-Corsica feeder convergence neighborhood, offshore Ligurian arc, then eastern Provencal handoff. Excludes separate Corsica feeder lengths and downstream Gulf of Lion/Catalan continuation.

name: Loop Current
scope: Yucatan Strait entrance to western Florida Strait handoff using a declared extended Loop phase. Detached rings, Caribbean upstream and Florida Current downstream are excluded.

name: Mauritanian Current
scope: Declared summer surface branch from offshore Senegal/Dakar source neighborhood to Cap Blanc handoff. Excludes winter poleward undercurrent north of21N, Canary equatorward jet and Guinea Dome loops.

name: Mediterranean Undercurrent
basin: Gulf of Cádiz / southwest Iberian Atlantic margin

name: Mindanao Current
scope: Southward Philippine eastern-boundary regional route from a near-surface NEC bifurcation gate at 14.3 N to an OSW southern Mindanao approach gate at 5.5 N. Excludes downstream Indonesian Throughflow, NECC and EUC routes, Mindanao and Halmahera eddy circuits, and Mindanao Undercurrent. The southern gate is an editorial regional limit, not an established whole-current endpoint.

name: Monsoon Current
scope: Declared southwest-monsoon principal corridor from offshore western Arabian Sea source handoff to Bay of Bengal turning/handoff east of Sri Lanka. Excludes Somali boundary legs, equatorial Wyrtki jets, coastal WICC/EICC lengths and uncertain farther-east branch.

name: New Guinea Coastal Current
basin: Southwestern tropical Pacific / north New Guinea coast

name: North Atlantic Current
scope: NOAA glossary regional continuation from the vicinity of 40 degrees N, 50 degrees W southeast of Grand Banks toward the western approaches of the British Isles. OSW chooses a nominal terminal gate west of Ireland, with southern/northern approach alternatives. Excludes Gulf Stream upstream, branches toward Iceland, the onward Norwegian/Canary flows and recirculation. A selected approach route is not the length of the entire branching Gulf Stream System.

name: North Brazil Current
scope: Northwestward surface North Brazil regional branch from an OSW gate near the source-described 5 S origin to a nominal 7 N retroflection approach. Alternative terminal conventions stop at 5 or 9 N. Excludes upstream North Brazil Undercurrent, offshore retroflected return branch, NECC/EUC continuations, Guiana continuation and detached ring tracks or perimeters. No whole circulation-system length asserted.

name: North Cape Current
scope: North Cape Current principal eastward reference extent from the offshore North Cape sector into the western Barents entrance sector.

name: North Pacific Current
scope: NOAA glossary regional extent from about 160 degrees E to an OSW gate at 145 degrees W, somewhat beyond the source's approximate 150 degrees W region. Alternative ends at 150 degrees W. This convention excludes downstream Alaska/California branches and the Kuroshio Extension. It is not the entire Japan-to-North-America circulation or a universal naming extent; AMS describes a different western origin near 170 degrees W.

name: Northern Current
scope: Regional Ligurian-to-Catalan Northern Current reference route ending at an OSW gate near the source-described 40.6 N bifurcation, with an earlier Catalan termination alternative. Excludes the Corsica feeder currents, downstream Ibiza and Balearic branches and offshore eddies. Exact gates and vertices are OSW choices; not the full western Mediterranean circulation.

name: Norwegian Current
scope: Norwegian Current named-flow reference extent northeastward off Norway from the southern offshore feed approach to the northern North Cape handoff.

name: Norwegian Atlantic Slope Current
scope: Author-reported approximate3500km eastern shelf-edge branch extent in Orvik and Skagseth (2003). Historical broad branch geography from Shetland toward the Arctic west of Svalbard at80°N is described in Orvik and Niiler (2001), not an independent length measurement. This broad scope may overlap flow now named West Spitsbergen Current; not an additive component length or a modern regional axis. No fixed layer, reference period, paired endpoint coordinates, error or annual range supplied.

name: Norwegian Coastal Current
scope: OSW southern Norwegian Skagerrak approach to the Ingoy section at the Barents Sea entrance, following a simplified offshore coastal corridor. Excludes Baltic source-water transit, Jutland inflow, fjord circuits, offshore Norwegian Atlantic Current branches, West Spitsbergen and downstream Murman continuation. No whole connected-system length.

name: Oyashio
scope: Selected southwestward Oyashio corridor south of Bussol Strait, followed by the first intrusion along eastern Honshu, to an OSW nominal gate at 40 N. Alternative southern gates use seasonal index limits at 38.5 N in April and 41.5 N in December. Excludes upstream East Kamchatka Current, Sea of Okhotsk circuits, offshore return branch into Subarctic Current, eastward Oyashio Extension/front and detached eddies. This branch convention is not the complete Oyashio system.

name: Pacific Equatorial Undercurrent
scope: Approximate basin-wide eastward pathway from north of Papua New Guinea to the South American coast described in Grenier et al. (2011). The source's 14,000 km is a broad path estimate, not a traced instantaneous core or the length of the Atlantic or Indian Equatorial Undercurrent. A 0°N, 140°W mooring locates the current independently.

name: Pacific North Equatorial Current
scope: Pacific NEC principal basin-crossing reference extent from the eastern tropical Pacific turning sector to the approach to the Philippine bifurcation.

name: Pacific North Equatorial Countercurrent
scope: Pacific NECC principal eastward basin reference extent from the offshore western recirculation/feed sector toward the Costa Rica Dome approach.

name: Pacific South Equatorial Current
scope: Pacific SEC principal reference route from the Peru-feed/eastern tropical sector across the southern tropical Pacific, north of Fiji/Vanuatu, into the Coral Sea approach to the Australian bifurcation.

name: Peru (Humboldt) Current
scope: Approximate 6,000 km Humboldt Current belt from southern Chile toward northern Peru and the Galápagos, reported in an embedded Purca et al. manuscript in Purca Cuicapusa's 2005 thesis. This is a broad eastern South Pacific current-system extent, not a measured core streamline or the Peru Coastal Current alone; the manuscript separately describes its 1,000 km Peru study area.

name: Portugal Current
scope: OSW offshore reference corridor from a selected gate within the 45-50 N North Atlantic/Azores interface region to a selected 35 N Canary feed-region gate. Excludes Portugal Coastal Current, Portugal Coastal Countercurrent, slope undercurrents, Azores eastward jet and downstream Canary route. No whole connected-system length.

name: Somali Current
scope: Northeast-monsoon southward Somali coastal branch from an OSW northern gate at 7 N to an OSW confluence gate at 3 S. Source latitude ranges are 6-8 N for divergence and 2-4 S for confluence with East African Coast Current. Excludes the northward flow north of the divergence, offshore feeder, eastward continuation, undercurrents and gyre circuits. No year-round whole-current extent asserted.

name: South Atlantic Current
scope: South Atlantic Current principal southern subtropical surface-reference extent from the Brazil–Malvinas separation/turning sector to the eastern Benguela-feed sector.

name: South Australian Current
scope: Winter South Australian component from the eastern Great Australian Bight region to the western approaches of Bass Strait under Ridgway and Condie's naming convention. Nominal offshore regional gates at 135.5 and 142.5 degrees E are OSW choices. Excludes Leeuwin flow west of the Bight, Zeehan continuation off Tasmania, gulf outflows and summer reversal. Does not allocate every transition region of the 5,500 km system.

name: South Indian Current
scope: South Indian Current principal southern subtropical reference extent from the eastern Agulhas-return transition sector to the offshore west-Australian turning sector.

name: South Java Current
scope: Declared surface South Java/Sumatra coastal-system convention from offshore southwest Sumatra to Lombok handoff. Excludes upstream basin SECC, downstream Savu/Ombai branches and South Java Undercurrent.

name: South Pacific Current
scope: South Pacific Current principal southern subtropical reference extent from east of New Zealand across the subtropical-front sector to the eastern-basin northward-turning sector.

name: Southern East Madagascar Current
scope: Author-reported approximate southern branch extent from about 20°S to Cap Sainte Marie near 25°30′S. Contextual literature estimate citing Duncan (1970) and Lutjeharms (1988b), not a new April 2001 path measurement. Coordinates, reference axis, fixed layer, reference period and error unspecified.

name: Spitsbergen Atlantic Current
scope: Spitsbergen Atlantic named-flow reference extent northwestward off southwest Spitsbergen, under the NOAA glossary interpretation.

name: Tasman Front
scope: Declared Australia-New Zealand connection from EAC separation offshore New South Wales to offshore northern North Island handoff. Excludes upstream EAC and downstream East Auckland flow.

name: Tsushima Current
scope: Japanese coastal-branch reference corridor from an OSW eastern Tsushima Strait approach to a western Tsugaru Strait approach. Excludes the offshore/Korean branch, Soya continuation and the separately named Tsugaru outflow. Connecting vertices do not assert uninterrupted flow or a full-system length. Downstream merges are shared circulation context, not exclusive nearshore water-parcel continuity.

name: West Australian Current
scope: West Australian Current principal offshore northward return reference extent from the southern subtropical turning sector to the SEC-feed approach.

name: West Greenland Current
scope: Northward shelf-break West Greenland branch from an OSW Cape Farewell approach gate to an OSW Davis Strait gate near 67 N. Excludes the separate inshore West Greenland Coastal Current, the westward branch joining Labrador Current, shed Irminger Rings, fjords, upstream East Greenland/Irminger paths and continuation beyond the chosen Davis Strait gate. Not the whole bifurcating West Greenland Current system.

name: West India Coastal Current
scope: Declared west-India surface coastal envelope from offshore Gujarat to offshore southwest-tip handoff near8N. Excludes coastal undercurrent, Laccadive gyre detours and Sri Lanka monsoon flow.

name: West Spitsbergen Current
scope: OSW reference corridor from a selected Barents Sea opening northward-departure approach at 73 N, west of Bear Island and Svalbard, to a selected pre-branching gate near 79.6 N. Excludes upstream Norwegian Atlantic routes, eastward Barents inflow, offshore Front Current feeder, westward recirculation, shelf/fjord intrusions and downstream Svalbard/Yermak/Yermak Pass branches. No whole connected Arctic pathway length.

name: Western Adriatic Current
scope: Po-region offshore approach to western Otranto along the Italian Adriatic coast. Regional surface route, not the whole vertically structured western Adriatic circulation. Excludes eastern boundary inflow, cross-basin gyre circuits, Gulf of Manfredonia recirculation, deep dense-water pathways and downstream Ionian continuation.

name: Zeehan Current
scope: Winter Zeehan component from the western Bass Strait approach, southward off western Tasmania, around its southern tip and toward the southern east coast. Regional gate coordinates are OSW choices. Excludes the South Australian segment, East Australian Current and offshore eddy excursions; not the full western/southern Australian boundary-flow system.
